title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Boss, let's go grab a bite. On you this time. What? You bought last time? Doesn't sound right to me.

title: Talk 1
original: Use my head to win fights? Hmm… Hmm… Pummel them until I win, train harder if I lose. That's using your head!

title: Talk 2
original: Honey's sweet, but getting it hurts. I went for some the other day… They really give me a hard lesson.

title: Talk 3
original: My knuckles? Haha~ They're my precious babies. Wouldn't have racked up all those wins without 'em!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: There's more rules in the underground fight scene than you might think. Plenty of gopniks dove in before they had 'em figured out. They usually ended up dead.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Oripathy? Who cares? Infected, Uninfected... They're all the same after I knock their lights out.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: What? The fin in the kitchen? Hah! Right here in my belly now!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: My book of names here? Ah, looks like that big brain of yours doesn't know everything. Gotta meet people to fight people, right? I don't want to run out of enemies.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: The only reason I joined the underground fight is 'cause I didn't have two kopecks to rub together. But here on Rhodes Island I got that load off my mind. It's all thanks to you, Boss!

title: Idle
original: Smells like grilled fish!

title: Onboard
original: Yo! Boss, you know a winner when you see her! Now, put your hands together for the strongest underground fighter out there. The one! The only! BEEEEEEEE-HUNTERRRRRR!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I really don't wanna study. Send me out to fight already!

title: Promotion 1
original: Hah hah hah! Somebody likes me a lot!

title: Promotion 2
original: Hah! After this promotion, ain't no way I'm gonna let you down! Lemme show you what I can do in a fight, Boss!

title: Added to Squad
original: Here I come!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Chow's on me after we win this one!

title: Depart
original: Relax, Boss. Ain't nobody can go three rounds with me!

title: Begin Operation
original: So you're the ones looking for a beatdown. You guys?

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: What's up?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Ready?

title: Deployment 1
original: Gimme the bell!

title: Deployment 2
original: Let's do this.

title: In Battle 1
original: Eat this!

title: In Battle 2
original: Get over here!

title: In Battle 3
original: One-two, one-two, one-two!

title: In Battle 4
original: C'mon, c'mon! Bring it on!

title: 4-star Result
original: The stronger the matchup, the more pumped I get!

title: 3-star Result
original: K.O.! Check it out, Boss. See 'em all piled up there?

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: That's a wrap. Let's head back and chow down!

title: Operation Failure
original: Ouch… Where's the Boss? Is the Boss okay?!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: This room's a lot better than any I had before!

title: Tap
original: Hm?

title: Trust Tap
original: You brought food? You're the best, Boss!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Hey, hey, hey! There you are, boss! I was just out having some honey with the others! Man, it's nice to have a stable income. Now I can buy as much honey as I want. Sure beats gathering it myself, with all the stinging... You're the best, boss!

title: Greeting
original: What's up, Boss.

title: Birthday
original: Honey-grilled fins! I just came up with the recipe a few days ago, and it's sure to be a blast! Same goes for fin jerky with honey. Why aren't I sharing any then? I couldn't hold myself back and ate it all last night.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: The way Rhodes Island fights is different from what I'm used to, but that doesn't bother me one bit! And I only learned after coming here how many people look down on the Infected. But don't worry! Me and my fist will change their minds!
